These Writ Petitions are filed for issuance of Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus to call for the records of the 2nd respondent's order passed in Award No.5 of 2020 dated 31.12.2020, in proceedings bearing Na.Ka.No.1704/2010/Aa 1, dated 31.12.2020 and quash the same and direct the respondents herein to re-calculate the compensation as applicable to the respective petitioners and settle the compensation along with the admissible interest under the Act.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.35365, 35414 and 35429 of 2023 2.

Today (12.01.2024), when the matter is taken up for hearing, the respondents filed counter and it is submitted by the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents that pending writ petitions, the differential compensation amount was recalculated proportionately and was also disbursed to the writ petitioners and therefore, the writ petition have become infructuous.
3. Recording the above submission of the learned Special Government Pleader, these Writ Petitions are dismissed as infructuous.

Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petitions in W.M.P.
Nos.35346, 36268 and 35395 of 2023 are closed.
W.M.P.No.35344 of 2023 in W.P.No.35365 of 2023 is ordered subject to payment of separate Court fee by the other writ petitioner.
There shall be no order as to the costs.
